statistical_scope.interpretation: Fixed split: average noise repeats within each model, then summarize the three training-seed means; SVM is one deterministic model. Variation is not a sampling-population confidence interval.

statistical_interpretation.networks: Equal mean of 3 model means; error bars are training sample SD (ddof=1).
statistical_interpretation.noise: 5 repeats are averaged within each fixed model and SNR first. Noise sample SD (ddof=1) is within-model variation, recorded separately; it is not plotted as training variation or a confidence interval.
statistical_interpretation.svm: One deterministic model; no fabricated training seeds or training error bars.
statistical_interpretation.confidence_intervals: None. Fixed-split variation is not population uncertainty.
statistical_interpretation.clean_confusion: Clean only: row percentages per model, then equal mean over 3 network training seeds; SVM single matrix. class_index 0..19.
statistical_interpretation.verification_scope: Report/summary consistency and file SHA only; CSV rows are not parsed and predictions are not independently verified.
